# v1.0.4 · Plays nice with others

### What's new

- **Shares the keyboard with SignalRGB.** TrackDeck now skips the replies meant for other programs on the keyboard's command channel, so the card keeps updating while SignalRGB streams lighting.
- **Words instead of symbols.** The tray status says Playing and Paused.
- **Meet Admiral.** [Admiral](https://github.com/yourgirljolyne/Admiral) shows this same card, plus custom keys and FN + arrow screen switching while SignalRGB runs, from one tray icon, and picks up TrackDeck's settings. TrackDeck won't start while Admiral is running, so the two never fight over the screen.

**Full changelog:** [v1.0.3...v1.0.4](https://github.com/yourgirljolyne/TrackDeck/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4)
